title: Description
description: What a connector exposes, returned once by its `describe` tool.

FieldDescription.description: One field a connector exposes. `of` is a fact about the source; `changes: true` marks a count.

identity.description: The identity rule, for example `youtube:video:<video id>`.

scopes.description: Scope arguments the list tool accepts (channel, playlist, subreddit, ...).

list_tool.description: The tool that lists items and the tool that fetches one.

Listing.description:
`full`: the pages name everything in scope, so a key missing from a completed listing was
deleted. `feed`: they do not (a search, a front page), so absence means nothing.
